en.dr-ali-peiravi: 6-42 Hamzih ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alavi - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa’id al-Hamedany quoted on the authority of Yahya ibn al-Hassan ibn Ja’far, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Maymun al-Khazzaz, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Maymun, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad , on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ali ibn al-Hussein (MGB) that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “There are six

damned by God and all the Prophets (whose call is accepted): Those who add to God’s Book; those who deny the Divine decree; those who abandon my traditions; those who allow what God has forbidden regarding my Itrat ; those who take power by force to debase those whom God has honored; and honor those whom God has debased; those who dedicate the Muslim’s booties to himself, and make them legitimate for himself to use.”
